p1_findings.finding: The sealed milestone verifies the M218 service island by driving groups directly. It does not instantiate M216 and does not replay a cycle-by-cycle finite-memory response schedule through the connected pair.
p1_findings.scope_effect: M216's 4.764209001x result remains an always-ready standalone frontend result. M218's 4.952121573x service ratio and 4.214618919x conservative composed lower bound remain fixed-latency premodel values, not RTL-measured complete-FC2 speedups.
p1_findings.required_followup: After service-only DC, add a connected M216-to-M218 wrapper and a cycle-exact L4/O8/II1 response model, then miter accepted group/request/result/done counts and cycles against the frozen recurrence.

p1_findings.finding: The VCS suite is deterministic directed verification. Its SVA checks handshake stability, bounds and conservation, while the testbench scoreboard checks exact context ownership and arithmetic; it is not an exhaustive formal proof or constrained-random campaign.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The suite is sufficient to open synthesis of this standalone block, but not to claim exhaustive protocol correctness under every legal backpressure and response permutation.
p1_findings.required_followup: Add randomized latency/backpressure/OOO seeds and formal safety properties for single-owner slot/context state, exact-once retirement and eventual completion under explicit fairness assumptions.

p1_findings.finding: The directed software miter uses signed INT8-typed values in the range -15 through +15. Independent static range analysis confirms that the RTL's signed9/signed10/signed11 tree covers the full eight-way INT8 range [-1024,1016], but -128/+127 and Acc24 overflow boundaries are not directly stimulated.
p1_findings.scope_effect: No arithmetic defect was found and the present directed numeric claim passes, but corner coverage is incomplete.
p1_findings.required_followup: Add full-scale -128/+127, mixed-sign cancellation, largest non-overflowing Acc24 prefix and one deliberate overflow attack before declaring numerical corner closure.

p1_findings.finding: The standalone service RTL has not yet passed DC/check_design. Its default implementation contains 18,432 registered accumulator-context bits and a 1,024-bit weight-response payload, in addition to FIFO and scoreboard state.
p1_findings.scope_effect: Executable VCS RTL does not establish area, timing, routability, macro inference or power. This is precisely the next service-only DC gate, not a blocker to opening that gate.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run exact-SHA service-only DC at the declared 3 ns point, fail on check_design issues, report sequential bits/cells and wide-bus critical paths, and label it pre-macro logic/register PPA only.

p1_findings.finding: frontend_done_had_event is forwarded to token_done_had_event but is not cross-checked against whether any group was accepted. M216 derives this field from accepted descriptors, so the intended composition is consistent, but M218 alone trusts the producer.
p1_findings.scope_effect: This cannot corrupt accumulated results, but a malformed producer can create inconsistent completion metadata without triggering protocol_error.
p1_findings.required_followup: At the connected wrapper, assert frontend_done_had_event equals the accumulated group-presence condition, or document it as a trusted interface invariant.

p1_findings.finding: The RTL explicitly assumes common POR for island and external memory. Soft flush is epoch-fenced, acknowledges before new headers and hard-faults after 1,024 missing-ack cycles, but no weight SRAM macro, context SRAM macro, memory fairness proof, Formality, PT, SAIF or PTPX result exists.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The milestone supports only a standalone functional service claim. It provides no macro-aware PPA, physical speedup, energy, complete FC2/FFN or system result.
p1_findings.required_followup: Keep the POR/flush/fairness assumptions explicit, then add macro adapters, Formality and post-DC timing/power only after service-only synthesis closes.

dc_admission_conditions: Synthesize only m218_fc2_tagged_slice_service_island with the fixed O8/FIFO4/SLICE16/timeout1024 geometry.
Pin the reviewed RTL SHA256 and fail on analyze/elaborate/check_design/report parsing errors.
Report the 18,432 context bits as registers unless a separately verified macro mapping is introduced.
Treat the 1,024-bit response as an external registered-boundary payload and disclose wide-bus timing paths.
Label area/timing as service-only pre-macro logic/register results; do not combine with M216 area or premodel speedup without connected evidence.
